0022600089.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Utah Jazz visit the Memphis Grizzlies, and the Jazz will be without Jusuf Nurkic (foot), Tony Bradley (quadriceps) and Trey Alexander (knee), all listed as out. The teams split their 2025-26 series 2-2, and Utah's most recent meeting was a 147-101 win in Salt Lake City on April 10, 2026. Memphis is missing Isaiah Stewart, who is day-to-day with an ankle injury and is a game-time decision.
